name: frp-game
description: 自托管网页桌游平台：一个零依赖 Node 进程 + 账号/好友/房间，8 个游戏（3 个自建 + 无名杀/狼人杀/斗地主/大富翁/莲花广麻）；面向小团体，禁止商用

scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser.smoke.mjs && node tests/room.browser.mjs && node tests/login-race.browser.mjs && node tests/shared.browser.mjs && node tests/react-lock.browser.mjs && node tests/werewolf.browser.mjs && node tests/ddz.browser.mjs && node tests/monopoly.browser.mjs && node tests/mahjong.browser.mjs && node tests/mahjong.join.browser.mjs && node tests/fullscreen.browser.mjs
scripts.test:ddz: node --test games/ddz/tests/*.test.mjs && node --test tests/ddz.test.mjs && node tests/ddz.browser.mjs
scripts.test:mahjong: node --test tests/mahjong.test.mjs && node tests/mahjong.browser.mjs && node tests/mahjong.join.browser.mjs
